performance.verdict: Spend is live but conversion tracking is broken; 6 SOW milestones overdue.

findings.text: Zero leads recorded across all 28 days despite $1,045.48 in Google spend and 11 Google Ads conversions — GHL/pixel disconnect confirmed.
Intake owner overdue since 2026-08-31: Vivian left 7/7, speed-to-lead automations point at an empty seat, blocking all scale-up decisions.
5 additional SOW milestones overdue (Booking bot 7/31, Review Boost, Financing page, Homer Glen branch all 8/31, LSA re-enable 9/1) — none completed.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 3 consecutive days (8/31–9/2) vs a prior 28-day total of 113 — organic visibility stalling as paid ramps.
GHL shows 59 opportunities created and 26 won in 28 days with $0 pipeline value recorded — pipeline dollar fields unpopulated, obscuring true job revenue.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL lead source mapping and Google Ads conversion tag immediately — $1,045.48 spent with 0 attributed leads is a tracking break, not a lead drought.
suggestions.monday_update: Pull the Google Ads conversion tag from the website and confirm it fires on the thank-you or form-submit event; cross-reference against the 11 conversions Google Ads itself recorded vs 0 in GHL. The gap — 11 tracked by Google, 0 in GHL — is the confirmation of a disconnect. Success is GHL showing leads that match or approximate the Google-reported 11 conversions. Resolve by 2026-09-06 before any budget decision is made.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login before any budget increase — scale-up gate is explicitly blocked until this is resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: Contact Sohib and Xavier to name the person who replaced Vivian on dispatch intake and confirm their GHL login is active with speed-to-lead automations tested. This is the formal scale-up gate per the SOW. Success is a named owner, verified GHL access, and one test lead routed correctly. Must be closed by 2026-09-06 or budgets stay throttled.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery over next 3 days — 3-day zero streak (8/31–9/2) may reflect Windsor data lag per SOW caveat, not true drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for three consecutive days ending 9/2, down from a 28-day total of 113 actions. The SOW flags Windsor data lag on the last 2–3 days of any GBP window, so this may self-correct. Re-check on 2026-09-06: if actions remain at or near 0 for a 6-day streak, escalate as a GBP visibility issue. No action until then.
